rule: Master shape: determined ONCE from the frozen shell file itself (full-image grounding + enlarged-crop grounding consensus, 2026-11-16). All composites use ONLY these numbers. Re-measuring positions from any generated art is forbidden. The shell files are frozen byte-for-byte; their SHA-256 hashes are recorded here and verified before every build.

scenery.method: photorealistic photo per kind, perspective-warped ONLY onto the master glass quad expanded x1.05 about the quad centroid (coeffs derived mechanically from glass_quad_px), horizon normalised to v=0.52 of the quad

shell_note: shell-back.png RGB is used pixel-for-pixel as frozen. Its alpha channel is NOT used: the glass opening alpha is rebuilt mechanically from glass_quad_px via v31 build_mask (inset 0.020, mullion 0.024) on every build, so the opening is a pure function of the master numbers.
